Name: Bregs Flooring
Author: Bregodon
Description:
[color=#ffd966][size=3][b]Bregs Flooring is a complete retexture of all decor floors and paths.[/b][/size][/color]

The goal is to enhance the floors to intensify the game experience.
The decor paths still stay close to the vanilla ones to preserve the beloved Stardew Valley feeling.

[color=#93c47d][size=3][b]Compatible with SDV 1.3 beta[/b][/size][/color]

----------

[color=#6d9eeb][size=3][b]Content[/b][/size][/color]

This is a combination of different other mods concerning the flooring.xnb file with my own modifications. Credits belong to the following authors included in this mod. Please check out their awesome work!
﻿
[color=#e69138]    Wood Floor[/color]: [i]Vanilla[/i]
[color=#b6b6b6]    Stone Floor[/color]: [b]Maleha[/b] from [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/a-whole-bunch-of-things-pets-paths-stable-etc.111044/]here[/url] [i](town floor)[/i] with modifications [i](sharp edges)[/i]
[color=#BF9000]    Weathered Floor[/color]: [i]Vanilla[/i] with modifications [i](border single tile)[/i]
[color=#3c78d8]    Crystal Floor[/color]: [b]Maleha[/b] from [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/a-whole-bunch-of-things-pets-paths-stable-etc.111044/]here[/url] [i](smaller tiles)[/i] with modifications [i](added boundaries) [/i]
[color=#ffd966]    Straw Floor[/color]: [b]Maleha[/b] from [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/a-whole-bunch-of-things-pets-paths-stable-etc.111044/]here[/url] [i](added straw on single sideway tiles)[/i]
[color=#999999]    Gravel Path[/color]: [b]NordKitten[/b] from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/574/?]here[/url] [i](bugfixing single pixels on floor area)[/i]
[color=#e69138]    Wood Path[/color]: combined pattern [b]NordKitten[/b] from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/574/?]here[/url] [i](crossing woods)[/i] with modifications[i] (recolored, shade fixes, pixel shift)[/i]
[color=#93c47d]    Crystal Path[/color]: combined pattern [b]Eemie[/b] from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/607/?]here[/url] [i](close, small and colored stones)[/i] with coloring [b]Nintonen[/b] from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/953/?]here[/url] [i](vivid color)[/i]
[color=#cccccc]    Cobblestone Path[/color]:[i] [i]Vanilla[/i][/i] with modifications [i](recolored)[/i]
[color=#b6b6b6]    Stepping Stone Path[/color]: [i][i] [i]Vanilla[/i][/i][/i] with modifications ([i]recolored, reshaped, shade fixes)

[/i]----------[b][size=3]

[color=#6d9eeb]Options[/color][/size]
[/b]
﻿[i]configurable via config.json, automatically created after first startup[/i]

[color=#ffd966][size=3] ﻿{...}Floor[/size][/color][size=3][color=#ffd966] (true/false)[/color]
[/size] ﻿ ﻿enables or disables the specific floor
[color=#ffd966][size=3]
﻿{...}Path[/size][/color][size=3][color=#ffd966] (true/false)[/color]
[/size] ﻿ ﻿enables or disables the specific path

----------

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=3]Installation[/size]
[/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
